## generic_dense_field_gen4

**No semantic generator issue found in the sampled contract.** Generator source
SHA-256: `645879ec1d9915be55f649ba9951a53d6fc8f4b0047d99b0bffc4135e98ed95a`.
I generated 100 tasks per difficulty (300 total), covering factors 2–4 where
advertised. Across 1,461 pairs / 1,439 unique inputs there were zero generation,
determinism, dimension, density, block-uniformity, nonconstant-output, or
Python-downscale parity errors. A same-shape top-left crop rival and a modal-fill
rival disagreed on all 1,461 pairs. Evidence and the reusable probe are
`checks/audit/generic_dense_field_gen4-custom.json` and
`checks/audit/run_generic_dense_field_audit.py`.

**Tooling/domain issue.** The prescribed source-bound check cannot start for this
generic target: `generator_battery_subject.py` requires a literal module-level
`PROGRAM`, while this generator constructs `program` from the sampled factor.
The command exits before lint with `ValueError: generic generator has no literal
PROGRAM`; see `checks/audit/generic_dense_field_gen4-lint.log`. This is not a
semantic counterexample, and the audit target was not changed.
